title: fix(runtime)!: refuse a flow resume body that carries both `inputs` and `variables`
body:
Fixes #24546
Clause-②: no (narrowing). Basis: no key, shape, export or error code is added. A resume body the route used to answer `200` while discarding its `variables` bag now answers `400`.

## What changed

`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/runs/:runId/resume` accepts `inputs`, `variables`, `output` and `branchLabel`. `variables` is an accepted alias of `inputs`, and the signal assembly reads `b.inputs ?? b.variables`. So a body carrying both keys answered `200 success:true`, the run resumed on the `inputs` bag, and the `variables` bag was never read. That held even when the bag carried a field the screen does not declare, which sent alone is refused `400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`.

The lane's pick on the card (claim comment 6269985720) was to **refuse**. The resume arm in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` now throws the route's own validation failure for a body carrying both keys:

- It sits after the unknown-key refusal (commit a4331227b) and the value-shape refusal, so both keep their messages for every body.
- It sits before `refuseUnrelatedResume` and `resume()`, so the engine is never consulted and the paused run stays parked for a corrected retry.
- A key whose value is `undefined` counts as absent, the same reading the value-shape check already uses.
- The assembly line `b.inputs ?? b.variables` is unchanged. At most one of the two keys can reach it now, so it drops nothing.

A body carrying either key alone is forwarded and judged exactly as before. The `variables` alias is **not** retired or deprecated (a hold-off on the claim). Its producers are counted below for the seat.

## Before and after: the both-keys body, measured through the route

Reading taken over a real Hono socket: `LiteKernel` + `HonoServerPlugin` (port 0) + `createDispatcherPlugin({ prefix: '/api/v1' })`, signed in. The automation slot is a scripted engine that plays showcase's `showcase_reassign_wizard` `collect` screen: one declared field, `new_assignee`, and an undeclared key is refused `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`. `engineCalls` is what the engine was handed.

"Before" swaps in `automation.ts` at the base (`2667e2402`, blob `65c9cffd`) in the working tree only. "After" is this branch's head `eb51ced02` (blob `455f28ad`). The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD`, its blob checked equal to HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` read empty. The scratch measurement file was deleted and is not in the diff.

Body `{"inputs":{"new_assignee":"inputs-win@example.com"},"variables":{"new_assignee":"variables-lost@example.com","bogus_key":1}}` (the card's own body) to `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/runs/run_1/resume`:

| | status | answer | engine handed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before (`2667e2402`) | **200** | `{"success":true,"data":{"success":true,"output":{"assignee":"inputs-win@example.com"}}}` | `{"variables":{"new_assignee":"inputs-win@example.com"}}`, so the `variables` bag was dropped |
| after (`eb51ced02`) | **400** | `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the envelope below | nothing: `resume()` never called |

The card measured the "before" row on stock showcase at `5b14b7f3` (200, the run completed, the task's assignee was the `inputs` value). After the fix the refusal fires before the engine, so the engine composition plays no part in the "after" row.

## The refusal's envelope

The same shape the route's closed-set and value-shape refusals answer: thrown `validationFailure`, which both dispatcher error exits map to `400` + `error.code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'` + `details.fields[]`. As measured on the socket:

```json
{"success":false,"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","message":"Invalid resume body — `inputs` and `variables` were both sent; `variables` is an alias of `inputs` (the screen submission), so send `inputs` alone","httpStatus":400,"details":{"fields":[{"field":"inputs","code":"invalid_value","message":"sent together with `variables`, its alias — send `inputs` alone"},{"field":"variables","code":"invalid_value","message":"an alias of `inputs`, sent together with it — send `inputs` alone"}]}}}
```

- Both keys are located, each with its own entry, as the closed-set refusal does for unknown keys.
- The field code is `invalid_value`, the ADR-0114 catalog member for "rejected for a reason no other member names". The value is well-shaped; its sibling is the problem. `FieldErrorCode` is a closed catalog in `packages/spec`, so no new member was added (`packages/spec/**` is a hold-off).
- It is not `FLOW_FAILED`, which the console reads as terminal. It is on the retryable side with the other body refusals.

## Ablation and controls

New test `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-resume-inputs-variables.test.ts` (10 cases), beside `automation-resume-envelope.test.ts` and `automation-resume-value-shape.test.ts`, on the same harness. It covers:

- **Both keys:** the card's body, identical bags, two empty bags, and both keys beside `output` and `branchLabel` all get `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with `fields` locating `inputs` and `variables` (`invalid_value`), the message naming both keys and `send \`inputs\` alone`, and `resume` not called. The refusal also escapes `dispatch()` as the recognized validation-failure shape.
- **Ordering:** an unknown key is still reported first (`unknown_field`), then a mis-shaped value (`invalid_type`). An `undefined` `variables` is no conflict (200).
- **Controls:** `variables` alone with an undeclared field still gets the engine's `400 INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` (the bag reaches the engine). `variables` alone, valid, gets `200`. `inputs` alone, valid, gets `200`.

Ablation, run on the committed fix through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` (WRAP mode, restore armed). The anchor is the whole refusal block, which leaves `b.inputs ?? b.variables` reading as before. The mutation landed with anchor 1 to 0 and blob `455f28ad` to `bed62029`. Running the new file plus the envelope and value-shape files gave `Tests 5 failed | 56 passed (61)`:

- Red, all five both-keys cases. The card's body reads `was accepted (answered {"status":200,"body":{"success":true,"data":{"success":true,"output":{"assignee":"inputs-win@example.com"}...}}})`.
- Green, the other five cases in the new file and all of `automation-resume-envelope.test.ts` and `automation-resume-value-shape.test.ts`.
- Restored: the blob after restore equals HEAD's (`455f28ad`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

The test imports `../http-dispatcher.js` by relative path, so the subject is `src/`, not a `dist/`. No rebuild leg applies.

**One existing test edited (outside the claim's listed file surface).** `automation-resume-value-shape.test.ts` carried `it('keeps the \`variables\` alias, and \`inputs\` still wins when both are sent')`. Its second half pinned exactly the behaviour this card removes (both keys get `200`, `inputs` wins). That half is removed, and the alias half stays as `it('keeps the \`variables\` alias')` with a pointer to the new file. Nothing else in that file moved.

## `variables` producer census

Who sends `variables` in the body of this route today. Measured by grep, not guessed.

**objectstack at `eb51ced02`.** No production producer. Every hit is a test pinning the alias:

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts:490-495`: `{ variables: { note: 'hi' } }`, the alias pin.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-resume-envelope.test.ts:189-195`: the alias pin.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-resume-value-shape.test.ts:95` (`OBJECT_KEYS` includes `variables`, mis-shape refusals) and `:255-263` (the alias pin).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-resume-inputs-variables.test.ts`: this PR's cases.

These send `inputs` (or nothing), never `variables`:

- client SDK: `client.automation.resume()` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:5906-5923`) and the project-scoped `resume` (`:8237-8250`). The `signal` type declares only `inputs` / `output` / `branchLabel`.
- `packages/verify/src/handle.ts:866`: `{ inputs: input ?? {} }`.
- dogfood: `flow-durable-suspend.dogfood.test.ts` and `flow-trigger-record-credential-mask.dogfood.test.ts`.
- docs: `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (`:1034`, `:1172`, `:2288`, whose route table spells the body `{ inputs, output, branchLabel }`) and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` (`:461`, `:774`).
- examples: none.
- MCP `resume_run` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:1000-1001`) builds `signal.variables` in process and never sends this HTTP body.
- The only mention of `variables` as a body key outside tests is the released 17.1 notes (`content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx:355`), which list it in the closed set.

**objectui**, read-only shallow clone in this session's scratch directory, at `main` `8aa8e3e1` and at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `4016370a`. One producer, `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:446-447`, sends `JSON.stringify({ inputs })`. The other hits are tests asserting the URL only. No file that names the resume route sends `variables`.

So the alias has no measured producer outside this repository's own alias pins. Whether to retire it is the seat's question, and this PR does not touch it.

## Tests and gates, at head `eb51ced02`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. That is `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck: OK — 27 file(s) / 190 error(s) / 68 pinned signature(s) held`. The new test file compiles clean under `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `@objectstack/runtime` local suite (`vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`): `Test Files 423 passed (423)`, `Tests 6655 passed | 19 skipped (6674)`. The `repo` project (`test:repo`) is not touched by this diff and is declared to CI's `Test Core`.
- eslint over the three changed `.ts` files (`--no-inline-config`): exit 0, no findings.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 67 derived commands. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.
  - First pass: 65 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, no full build yet). `check:query-options-erasure` exited 1 with an ENOENT on a scratch file of mine that was in the tree for about 20 s while that ESLint scan ran (my error, not a gate finding).
  - After a full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (76/76 tasks): those two plus every dist-reading derived gate (`check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check-dts-emitted --self-test`) were re-run, all exit 0.
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: `67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (exit 0).
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: the changeset reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)` and is accepted.
- The 10 declared-wide families (`check:init-service-contract`, `check:live-db-isolation`, `check:meta-type-normalized`, `check:optional-error-sink`, `check:resume-authority-declared`, `check:runner-env-posture`, `check:settings-bind-window`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:verify-stand-in`, `check:wildcard-fallthrough`): all exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (the full union): `eslint . --no-inline-config` exit 0, no findings (138 s).
- Not measured locally, by the derivation's own account: the 4 workflow-variable commands (`check-issue-citations --census`, the three `check-shard-attestation --emit` jobs). They carry CI-only values, and CI runs them.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24546-resume-inputs-variables-both-refused.md`: `'@objectstack/runtime': minor`, a `fix(runtime)!:` summary, a line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, one ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker with its reason, and the `**BREAKING** (...)` sentence ending "shipped as `minor` under the launch-window convention for breaking changes".

## Review owed before the queue

This narrows a public door's accepted bodies, so the seat owes **one review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`** before the queue (claim comment 6269985720). It is not run by the dev. This thread is left for that record.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/design/screen-flow-runtime.md:33` still spells the route `POST /api/v1/automation/runs/:runId/resume`, with no `:name` segment. It is a design note, not a reference page. Noted only.
- Read while choosing this refusal's field code: two other hand-built body refusals in this package put a code outside the ADR-0114 `FieldErrorCode` catalog on `details.fields[].code`.
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:959` (the run-lifecycle `cancel` / `restore-suspension` unknown-key refusal) uses `unrecognized_keys`. Measured through the domain handler, an operator's `cancel` with `{"foo":1}` answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[0].code: "unrecognized_keys"`, and `ApiErrorSchema` still parses it because `details` is untyped there.
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts:194` uses `invalid_string`.
  - Not touched here. Reported to the seat in the dev report.
